timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,400–1,418 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly—reaching a 10-month low of 1,418 KRW/USD and potentially attempting to break into the 1,300s. This means you are paying fewer yen for each dollar, which is unfavorable when you need to convert a fixed USD amount monthly. The news indicates July saw the won's strongest appreciation since 2009, driven by foreign hedge-ratio adjustments and domestic company currency conversions.

TIP: Consider waiting for the predicted range ceiling (~1,440 KRW/USD) or signs of won weakness before your next conversion, since 74% of individuals surveyed agree: "convert when the rate is lower (higher KRW/USD)."
